about: Wrecks on the seabed: runs that went wrong and classic bugs, each with its measured number. Entries come from the course session; tools/check_markers.py checks every number against the named code cell's saved output. Fields: id, station (e.g. basic-02), title, claim, number, cell (0-based index among the notebook's code cells).

wrecks.title: The perfect model
wrecks.claim: A column recorded after the result (certificate issued) slipped into the features. Test accuracy jumped from 0.832 to 1.000, and the model was useless: it read the answer.
